findings.title: CMEK topic and SCC notification config are created immediately after the IAM grants they rely on, with no propagation wait
findings.explanation: depends_on orders the graph but IAM grants return before they propagate (30-60s). The Pub/Sub topic validates CMEK access to var.kms_key_name at create, and the notification config is created right after granting the SCC service agent roles/pubsub.publisher on the topic, so a fresh first apply can fail with a permission error that only clears on retry. Principle is a best fit: this is an apply-time correctness issue. Other modules in this family already use time_sleep for exactly this.
findings.remediation: Insert time_sleep resources after the KMS grant (before the topic) and after the publisher grant (before the notification config).
